# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 5 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_005_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 5

**5:1** And on the next day he brought his offerings, saying within himself, "If the Lord God is propitious toward me, the headplate of the priest will make it manifest to me." And Joachim brought his gifts and observed attentively the headplate of the priest when he went up to the altar of the Lord, and he saw no sin in himself; and Joachim said, "Now I know that the Lord God has been propitious toward me and has remitted all my sins."

**5:2** And he went down from the temple of the Lord justified, and he went to his house.

**5:3** And the months were completed by Anna, and in the ninth month she gave birth. And she asked the midwife, "What have I brought forth?" And the midwife said, "A female child." And Anna said, "My soul is magnified this day." And she laid the child down.

**5:4** And when the days were fulfilled, Anna was purified and gave suck to the child and called her name Mary.
